accuracy.text: Welcome back to the weekly home show. Today we have three topics for you. First a quick word about the new community garden, then the main topic, and travel at the end. The community garden opens next month on the corner of Elm Street. Volunteers can sign up for a plot, and tools will be shared in a small shed by the gate. Bring your own gloves, and remember that the water tap is only turned on in the mornings. Now to our main topic, which is sleep. Most adults need between 7 and 9 hours of sleep every night. Keep the bedroom cool and dark, and put the phone away an hour before bed. If you cannot fall asleep after 20 minutes, get up and read until you feel tired. Finally, travel. Trains are often faster than flying for trips under 500 kilometers. Book early for the cheapest seats, and bring snacks for the journey.
